entries.mem0ai/mem0: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that implements a universal memory layer supporting User, Session, and Agent states. It features multi-signal retrieval and temporal reasoning, available via managed cloud or Apache-2.0 self-hosted OSS.

entries.garrytan/gbrain: An opinionated brain for OpenClaw/Hermes Agents that creates knowledge graphs with typed edges without requiring LLM calls. It supports multi-user company setups with scoped data access and provides synthesized answers with gap analysis and citations.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes Agent memory provider featuring a custom vector graph engine and byte-level deduplication for sub-300ms recall. It maintains auto-updated user profiles and supports multi-modal extraction from code, images, PDFs, and videos.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: A memory system focused on retain, recall, and reflect workflows for long-term agent learning. It is compatible with over 25 LLM providers and multiple database backends, deployable via Docker or Kubernetes.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: A stateful agent memory library that uses background reasoning to update peer representations from session history. It integrates with MCP and Claude Code, offering deployment options via managed service, local CLI, or Docker.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that treats memory as a git repository, using markdown context trees with commit, branch, and merge versioning. It features a 5-tier retrieval system and an interactive TUI powered by React/Ink.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency memory system for Hermes Agents utilizing a single SQLite database and one pure-Python dependency. It achieves sub-millisecond performance and features episodic compression for sub-linear storage growth.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: A seven-layer memory system for Hermes Agent that combines Qdrant persistent memory, structured facts, and an auto-curated wiki. It uses a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize injected context.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: A recursive context harness that generates filesystem-first artifacts such as traces, reports, and context bundles. It utilizes outcome-gated promotion to update context based on verified trials.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: A Lossless Context Management plugin for Hermes Agent that uses a hierarchical DAG and SQLite store to ensure no messages are lost. It provides specific recall tools, including lcm_grep and lcm_recall, for detail recovery.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: This tool indexes local session history from over 20 different coding agents to provide millisecond lookups over months of past data. It utilizes MCP recall for high-speed searches across gigabytes of history while redacting sensitive keys and tokens for safety.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This self-hosted backend enables private cross-session memory for Hermes Agent using Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis. It supports flexible inference by connecting to any OpenAI-compatible provider or local LLM server.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Plur provides a shared memory layer that stores knowledge locally as human-readable YAML engrams. It uses hybrid BM25 and embedding-based retrieval to inject context across global, team, and project-specific scopes.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: This local-first identity and memory layer achieves 97.6% answer accuracy on LongMemEval benchmarks. It automates memory construction from Discord, Obsidian, and office documents, integrating directly with Hermes Agent and Claude Code via plugins.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that operates entirely locally without cloud dependencies or API keys. It employs hybrid retrieval, combining BM25 and vector search, and integrates with agents through MCP and dedicated hooks.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: This file-based long-term memory system uses a five-tier hierarchical SQLite schema instead of vector databases or embeddings. It offers a specialized Hermes adapter and supports cross-platform deployment on Linux, macOS, and Windows.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This optimization tool reduces prefill latency by 1.5–3× and saves up to 36% of tokens through block reordering and deduplication. It features native plugin support for the Hermes Agent ecosystem to accelerate long-context inference.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This plugin provides explainable memory recall by attaching 'why_retrieved' tags to every result and tracking contradictions. It manages the memory lifecycle through consolidation passes and can run either as an embedded process or an HTTP backend.
entries.JanYork/llm-wiki-cli: This CLI serves as a machine interface for agent-driven knowledge maintenance, allowing agents to autonomously evolve persistent, source-grounded archives. It preserves temporal memory and citations without the need for a vector database.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn uses an Obsidian vault as a source of truth, storing durable memory as inspectable Markdown files with frontmatter. It utilizes a local DuckDB cache for hybrid search and integrates with coding agents via MCP servers.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system prefetches context by watching agent session logs and storing data locally using SQLite-vec. It is an MCP-native server that automates configuration for major coding agent clients.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack acts as a memory kernel that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single owner. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide agents with purpose-built evidence packets for every query.

entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This reflective memory system utilizes semantic search, BM25 full-text indexing, and ranked graph traversal for information retrieval. It features automated indexing for multimedia with OCR support and uses edge tags to create bidirectional relationships between notes.

entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: This Git-backed workflow layer manages context for coding agents like Claude Code and Codex using hash-checked proposals and receipts. It offers a source-neutral migration path for exporting chats and documents across different platforms.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes an embedded .lbdb graph database to surface high-priority memories through 1-10 importance ranking. It combines BM25 keyword search with optional GLiNER2 entity extraction to manage named graph relationships.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This episodic memory plugin features a pull-model that supports immediate event deletion and an on-demand summarizer. It provides a trace.jsonl audit log to track every prefetch and memory operation performed by the agent.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables agents to manage budget-bound wallets and process x402 payments using USDC across EVM and Solana chains. The system operates without a backend, database, or API keys for streamlined financial transactions.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes local artifacts such as scripts, cron jobs, and documentation to facilitate capability routing. It registers five native tools for searching and reporting artifact usage while automatically generating routing notes.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: Providing durable cross-session memory, this plugin uses a local SQLite reliability layer and write outbox for state persistence. It enables pre-turn context injection and session-end snapshots to maintain continuity across agent interactions.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 to provide self-organizing long-term memory for agents. It supports configurable query expansion and result reranking to improve the accuracy of manual and automated memory retrieval.

entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory provider features AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports HNSW ANN, sparse, and FM-index retrieval. It can be executed via native Rust FFI or as an HTTP daemon, offering metadata filtering and MinHash deduplication.

It further supports agent efficiency by implementing automatic context checkpointing during message compression.

It features dedicated 'rot' and 'lint' curators to identify stale or conflicting data, providing evidence-cited diffs for manual review.

entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi serves as a local coworking application featuring a built-in agent engine with full file read and write capabilities. It enables 24/7 automation via Cron and supports remote access through a WebUI or various messaging platforms.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Developed with Python and vanilla JavaScript, this interface allows users to access Hermes Agent via web browsers or mobile devices. It features a circular context ring for monitoring token usage and supports secure remote connections through SSH tunnels.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion simplifies the initial setup of Hermes Agent through guided installation and provider configuration. It provides a dedicated GUI for managing chat sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers in one place.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: This web dashboard facilitates multi-platform channel configuration for Telegram, Discord, Slack, and WhatsApp. It offers visual workflow building with human approval gates, scheduling, and detailed analytics for tracking token costs and model distribution.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers for complex tasks. It integrates a Monaco-based file browser, a PTY terminal, and dedicated managers for memory, skills, and MCP catalogs.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative coding workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes and other agents into desktop, standalone server, or Docker deployments. It includes fifteen built-in agents and offers native iOS and Android clients for remote mobile access.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Designed as a native Mac workspace, this tool provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts with an embedded terminal for shell access. It features native views for managing sessions, Kanban boards, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first application includes a specialized kernel with health check and update capabilities. The UI supports memory management and renders complex content like LaTeX and Markdown.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension links active browser context to local or remote Hermes runtimes. It allows users to toggle specific tabs for agent context and supports multi-agent group chats with synced conversation histories.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI app for iOS 18+ that connects directly to a self-hosted server without third-party relays. It enables mobile management of agent chats, scheduled tasks, skills, and server-side files.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: This desktop workspace offers one-click setup for Hermes Agent and other engines while providing custom LLM model routing. It includes a runtime dashboard for tracking latency and token usage, plus a live workspace for monitoring code writes and diffs.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This interactive TUI consciousness monitor features nine tabs and four color themes for tracking agent growth, git projects, and cron jobs. It includes a tmux operator view designed specifically for managing live agent panes.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard provides a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and an MCP server control plane for managing server lifecycles. It features the ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines alongside real-time chat and tool call visualization.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser that tracks per-session quota burn and estimated API costs across 15 agents. It allows users to search local prompts and tool calls while providing the ability to resume supported CLI sessions in Terminal, iTerm2, or Warp.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS workspace facilitates one-click automated Hermes Agent installation on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It integrates a WebRTC voice mode utilizing OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP for remote agent interaction.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and React 19, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web interface. It includes a dedicated approval inbox for managing agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: Constructed with OpenTUI, this alternative interface provides a TUI for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It incorporates a kanban board for task management and supports the administration of profiles, skills, and toolsets.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This React-based mobile-first dashboard for Telegram Mini App v2.0 supports background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances. It features terminal chat with streaming responses and utilizes dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This portable Windows desktop application runs via embedded Python and Node.js runtimes without requiring installation or admin rights. It features a Tkinter GUI and includes 100 tools for tasks such as TTS, music generation, and ComfyUI automation.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: This glassmorphic web interface provides real-time log streaming and a file browser for self-hosted AI assistants. It includes management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers alongside a task tracking dashboard.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This dashboard focuses on process monitoring by providing real-time session activity and cost tracking. It allows for the full inspection of conversation histories and skill source code, plus read-only monitoring of environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A self-hosted workspace featuring real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards within a chat-first interface. It includes an integrated marketplace for skills and MCP servers, as well as isolated profile management for separate sessions and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This native desktop client orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents through a PM orchestrator. It features a Visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and supports streaming SSE responses with model switching.
